label: übernehmen

edition.check: Level 5: (a) input barcode 731456031125 (valid UPC-A, step 1) exactly matches this edition in >=2 independent sources: MET. MusicBrainz 41b0a392 (step 3/5, 0731456031125, Polystar 560 311-2, 2xCD DE 2000), Discogs 1949898 (step 6, scanned barcode), musik-sammler.de (step 17, EAN 731456031125, Polystar 560 311-2) and the back-cover print read via vision (step 8) all match. (b) Format and artist match: MET; 2xCD Various, title identical. (c) No other edition with the same barcode and a different tracklist: MET. The three Discogs hits with this barcode (step 2) share cat. no. 560 311-2. 23145932 has a verifiably identical tracklist (step 4). 26676554 was not fetched but has the same cat. no. and barcode, so it is a pressing variant. The club edition 610930 and 3796763 do not appear in the barcode search and are ruled out by the input barcode. All conditions met, so I stop at 5.
edition.summary: The barcode matches exactly in MusicBrainz, Discogs, musik-sammler.de and on the printed back cover, and all same-barcode Discogs variants are pressings with the same cat. no. and tracklist.

tracklist.check: Level 5: >=2 independent sources of the same edition agree on count, order and titles. MET. MusicBrainz (step 5) has 20+20 tracks. Discogs 1949898 (step 6) and 23145932 (step 4) have the same 40 tracks in the same order. The back cover (step 8) shows 40 tracks in the same order. musik-sammler.de (step 12) has 20+20 tracks in the same order. Remaining differences are only spellings or version suffixes: (Album Version), Straßen/Strassen, and mix names absent from the cover. There are also obvious typos on musik-sammler ('Nelly' at CD1-10, 'Form Jamaica', 'Shackless'). These do not affect count, order or titles. Level 5 met.
tracklist.summary: Four sources of the same edition (MB, Discogs, back cover, musik-sammler.de) agree on 40 tracks in identical order, with only spelling and version-suffix variants.

durations.check: 100% of tracks have a duration, 88% confirmed by >= 2 sources, 5 conflicts
durations.summary: 100% of tracks have a duration, 88% confirmed by >= 2 sources, 5 conflicts

sources.check: Level 5: database plus an independent primary source of the same edition. MET. The database Discogs 1949898 has independent details: matrix, Made in Germany, and the 560 312-2/560 313-2 sub-cat. nos. The primary source is the back cover read by vision (step 8), which shows the printed barcode 731456031125 and cat. no. 560 311-2 together with the full tracklist. The image is hosted on CAA/MusicBrainz, but it is a scan of the physical print and is independent of Discogs. MusicBrainz and musik-sammler.de give additional independent confirmation. Level 5 met.
sources.summary: Two independent databases plus a collector site are backed by a read back-cover print showing the same barcode and catalogue number.

concerns: Alternative discogs:release/26676554 (EU) was never fetched; the claim 'keine abweichende Trackliste' is unsupported, although it is plausible given the same barcode and cat. no.
Discogs 3796763 (Bravo Hits 30, 2xCD, step 10) is not listed among the alternatives and was not examined; its barcode is unknown.
Alternative 23145932 is described as a 'UK-Pressung', but Discogs lists its country as Germany; only the matrix says Made in the UK.
CD2-2: 'Straßen' was chosen although the cover, Discogs and musik-sammler all print 'Strassen'; this is a spelling issue only.
CD2-6: musik-sammler lists 'Stieber Twins' instead of Prodigal Sunn and CD1-10 artist 'Nelly'; these are collector-site errors not noted in the conflicts.
The result's confidence (0.9) differs from the written file (0.93); minor inconsistency.
